Each workflow was read by two independent agents whose counts had to agree, with disagreements re-read singly; notes are the readers' prose and are verified only where the runbook says so. Workflow names are normalised to drop the estate's em dash separator per the house rule; ids are the join key. Secret looking literals were redacted by the readers and the file was scanned before commit.

entries.name: DEVON Action Router, n8n lane (Build 05, half)
entries.trigger_summary: Webhook: POST /webhook/devon-action with header auth (x-devon-key), responds via Respond to Webhook nodes
entries.notes: Dispatch to Executor has no literal url; it posts to $json.target_url, resolved by the TARGETS allowlist inside the Authorise and Resolve Target Code node, which hardcodes three Cloud urls and three workflow ids: spine.echo -> /webhook/devon-spine-n8n (workflow Oi7o1sTEqhxhOaJL, ceiling read), drive.draft -> /webhook/devon-drive-draft (J7Ly7riwXEd95D9a, ceiling reversible_write), airtable.row -> /webhook/devon-airtable-row (ps2S6dWcTIpq5bvr, ceiling reversible_write). Those are HTTP dispatches, not Execute Workflow nodes, which is why execute_workflow_targets is empty. The workflow_id values are reported to the bus as target_workflow, so if the executors land on the target under new ids both the urls and the ids in TARGETS need changing. Both bus reports (ACTION_STARTED on entry, ACTION_COMPLETED or ACTION_FAILED on exit) go to the Cloud /webhook/devon-event url with timeout 15000 ms; Dispatch timeout is 75000 ms. Error workflow XDQXwgFkUhYxoEjG; saveDataErrorExecution is also none. The description states the Zapier lane is not built.

entries.name: DEVON Approval Queue

All three data table nodes point at approval_queue u6wzeN5y9LNxROsN (Store Pending insert; Find Request reads the latest 200 rows unfiltered ordered by createdAt DESC and the id match happens in Check Decision; Record Decision updates matched on request_id).
